subject: remove individual or marker from data file

messages.author: c4390b997ff96dbb
messages.subject: remove individual or marker from data file
parts:
I want remove 4 individuals [8, 35, 37, 90] from my datafile.

I tried:

library(qtl)

All_q50C50 <- read.cross("csvr", ".", "All_q50C50copy2a.csv", estimate.map=FALSE)

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [-90,]

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [-37,]

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [-35,]

All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [-8,]

 

and got the following for each line:

 

Warning message:

In matchchr(chr, names(x$geno)) : Chr 90 not found


How would I remove a single marker? several markers that are not consecutive?

 

Also, I wanted to confirm that the markers are columns and the individuals are rows in R/qtl.

thanks

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] remove individual or marker from data file
parts:
Try 

  All_q50C50 <- All_q50C50 [ , -c( 8, 35, 37, 90)]

Not the best design choice but with the square brackets for a cross object, you can use chromosomes before the comma and individuals after. It's a shortcut for the subset.cross function.

To remove markers, use the drop.markers function.

karl
